model: REQUIRED: same exact model in both arms
model_version: REQUIRED: record resolved version; unknown blocks scoring
reasoning: REQUIRED: same setting in both arms

tool_differences.git: Two writable Git worktrees; JSON-line messages and unfinished diffs; ordinary merges and conflict resolution; exact host-captured checks. No Falinks ledger or offer/reconsideration protocol.
tool_differences.falinks: Live group workspace; engine-mediated mutations and revision-bound reviews/offers; host-captured checks. Adapter/engine supplied by downstream tickets.
tool_differences.shared: Same two fresh identities, allocation, model/version/reasoning, requirements, dependency information, announcements, feedback opportunities, frozen milestones and trusted checks. No oracle/reference access.

auth_file: REQUIRED: auth.json for the isolated fresh CODEX_HOME
denied_roots: REQUIRED: checkout, other runs and any reference copies
